ai.summary: Business logic module for product management implementing SOLID principles. Provides ProductsService with dependency injection, interface segregation, and single responsibility. Includes repository and validation interfaces for extensibility. Supports full CRUD operations, filtering by category/seller/status, price range filtering, full-text search, and pagination. Uses Zod for robust validation aligned with database constraints.
use_cases: List products with filters (category, seller, status, price range)
Implement custom product repository (Supabase, Prisma, REST API)
Sort products by name, price, or date
examples: const products = await productsService.listProducts({ status: 'active', limit: 20 })
const newProduct = await productsService.createProduct({ name: 'Product', price: 99.99, sellerId: 'user-id' })
